card.name: The word enough after an adjective
card.fires_on: The word "enough" right after an adjective such as high, bold, thick, deep, bright or low. It is usually followed by "to" and a result.

modes.label: Adjective + enough + to
modes.description: Sufficiency phrase where "enough" follows a size, degree or quality adjective and leads into a result.

modes.label: Enough in a comparison of degree
modes.description: "enough" marks a needed threshold in a general-web description of conditions or costs.
modes.example: At present, costs are already low<< enough>> to make desalination an attractive option

card.plain: It lights up on the word "enough" when it means "sufficiently", as in "thick enough" or "close enough".
